g.text: GSE300977 | Positional structure across spatial states
A-C Preregistered secondary scan D Post-reveal common-anchor sensitivity
Shading: pointwise 95% bootstrap intervals; not multiplicity-corrected.
Dotted line: frozen +75-nt primary position. No secondary center is promoted to primary.
A-C use center-specific eligible units; D uses the same 3,510 anchors at all 11 centers.
